Every Now And Then is the second album by Australian dance-rock band Jagwar Ma. It was released in October 2016 under Future Classic in Australia and New Zealand, Mom + Pop Music in the United States, and Marathon in the United Kingdom and Europe.
The album was written and performed by band members Jono Ma and Gabriel Winterfield, and recorded and produced by Ma.
